# Bloomberg Government

> Bloomberg Government is an all-in-one public affairs and government news platform providing policy intelligence, legislation tracking, and federal spending analysis for government affairs professionals.

Bloomberg Government serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding federal and state policy developments, government contracting opportunities, and legislative changes. The platform combines news briefings, policy analysis, and decision-maker intelligence to support public affairs professionals and government stakeholders.

## Policy & Legislative News

- [Health Care Briefing: Jumbled Strategies Slowing Vaccine Rollout](https://about.bgov.com/news/health-care-briefing-jumbled-strategies-slowing-vaccine-rollout/): Health care briefing on vaccine rollout policy and federal strategies
- [Technocrat: Prime Way to Procure](https://about.bgov.com/news/technocrat-october-1-2018-prime-way-procure/): Technocrat column on federal procurement and government contracting
- [Technocrat: Moving Hybrid Cloud](https://about.bgov.com/news/technocrat-november-5-2018-moving-hybrid-cloud/): Technocrat column on hybrid cloud solutions for government affairs
